description: This file contains API client functions for user-related backend endpoints, including fetching user data, user projects, batch user projects, and user session details. It also includes a utility to wrap ISO strings into MongoDB ISODate format.

methods.name: wrapIsoAsMongoISODate(iso)
methods.description: Wraps an ISO string into a Mongo-shell style ISODate("...") expression for query parameters. If the input is falsy or already wrapped, returns it unchanged.

methods.name: getUserBasic(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a single user document by user ID from the backend API.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {}, options = {})
methods.description: Fetches distinct projects for a given user, with optional time range parameters formatted as MongoDB ISODate strings.

methods.name: getUsersProjectsBatch(body = {}, options = {})
methods.description: Fetches distinct projects for multiple users in batch via POST request. Accepts a list of user IDs and optional time range parameters in ISO string format.

methods.name: getUserSessionDetails(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Retrieves aggregated session details for a specified user, with optional query parameters.
